name: Requester
author: CabinetOS tests
description: A test fixture that sends requests to the core and reads its own settings.

capabilities.name: cmd:register
capabilities.reason: Adds the Ask the Core and Read a Setting commands.

capabilities.name: events:emit
capabilities.reason: Passes each event it hears on to the window.

capabilities.name: core:request
capabilities.reason: Asks the core for what its tests want. hello and secret_get are listed on purpose: the core refuses them whatever a manifest says.
